subject: Co-sell Private Offer: SKU entitlement mapping & billing cadence for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acmeanalytics.com>, partner_ops@cloudreseller.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Co-sell Private Offer: SKU entitlement mapping & billing cadence for Acme Analytics

Hi Alice / CloudReseller team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, Acme wants a Private Offer for the joint bundle (Redwood Dedicated + integration services). To move to Procurement and the marketplace private-offer flow we need to align on three things:

1) SKU & entitlement mapping — which Redwood SKUs will be surfaced in the Private Offer and how they map to Acme usage buckets (demo/trial/prod).
2) Billing cadence & meter breakdown — monthly vs. upfront, and how metering events (tokens/embeddings/instance-hours) will be reported to CloudReseller.
3) Evidence & legal — short evidence binder for the marketplace listing (security summary, SLA excerpt, co-sell doc).

Attached: acme_solution_manifest_v1.pdf — payload shows proposed bundle and suggested SKU mapping (draft).

Goal: get a working SKU map and metering sample this week so Redwood Marketplace team can draft the Private Offer template and Acme procurement can review.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed (4/12): confirm SKU mapping and billing cadence
- Fri (4/14): Redwood shares Private Offer draft + DocuSign PO (if procurement ready)

Ben / Kim — can you pick up the SKU numbering and a quick meter sample we can hand to Acme?

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: partner_ops@cloudreseller.io
Date: 2028-04-11T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell Private Offer: SKU entitlement mapping & billing cadence for Acme Analytics

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the clear next steps. The attached manifest is a good starting point. A few clarifications from Procurement and our platform team:

- We need the SKUs split into: trial (30d credit), pilot (metered monthly), and enterprise (committed monthly). Can Redwood provide suggested SKUs for each bucket and a quick table that maps usage thresholds to pricing tiers?
- For billing cadence, Acme prefers monthly invoicing via CloudReseller with token-level reporting (CSV) that we can reconcile. Can you provide a sample metering CSV?
- Our security team will need the standard evidence pack (SOC-2 summary + network diagram + data flow for integrations).

If you can share the SKU map and the metering_sample.csv by EOD Wednesday, Procurement will target internal review Thursday.

Thanks —
Alice Chen
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Acme Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell Private Offer: SKU entitlement mapping & billing cadence for Acme Analytics

Mateo / Kim —

I built a draft SKU table and a sample metering CSV. Key assumptions are in the first tab of the spreadsheet (attached as metering_sample.csv). Highlights:
- SKU-RWD-DED-STD: Dedicated instance hour (billed hourly, rolled into monthly invoice)
- SKU-RWD-TKN-001: Metred token units (1 unit = 1k generated tokens)
- SKU-RWD-EMB-001: Embedding calls (per 1000 embeddings)

Attached: metering_sample.csv (includes three demo rows for trial/pilot/prod).

Kim — can you confirm acceptance criteria for the marketplace metadata (pricing tiers, entitlements field) so I can bake that into the Private Offer template?

- Ben

Subject: Re: Co-sell Private Offer: SKU entitlement mapping & billing cadence for Acme Analytics

Thanks Ben — this looks good. Two operational asks from Marketplace intake:

1) Metadata keys: we need the following fields for the listing API — sku_id, display_name, unit_type (hour/token/embedding), min_purchase, billing_cycle, entitlement_tags. I'll add those to Ben's CSV.
2) Evidence binder: I'll attach the minimal set we can share for now (SOC-2 summary excerpt + network diagram). Acme, if you need a more detailed package we can open an evidence sprint with your security contact.

Next steps:
- I will update the CSV with the metadata keys and post the Private Offer draft (private_offer_template.docx) by EOD Thursday.
- Mateo / Ben, let's sync Fri morning (30m) to sign off before we hand to CloudReseller for PO issuance.

Kim
Marketplace Intake Lead — Redwood Inference

Alice / team —

Thanks — attached are the finalized artifacts we agreed on: metering_sample.csv (with metadata keys), private_offer_template.docx (filled with the ACME bundle SKUs), and the evidence stub. CloudReseller — please use the attached Private Offer draft to generate the DocuSign PO (linked below).

DocuSign (prepped): https://app.docusign.com/embedded/abcd1234
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-20276

If Procurement is ready we'll target signature next week. Action items:
- Acme: confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly invoice via CloudReseller) — reply-all with a thumbs up.
- CloudReseller: can you confirm that the Private Offer flows the SKU-level metering to your invoice system and include the expected file format?

Thanks everyone — good progress.
Mateo
